scenarios.name: Navigate through 50 folders of an Unreal-like project, one after the other
scenarios.notes: Total time for 50 navigations, each one starting as soon as the previous listing was painted (folders hold 10 to 31 items). Per navigation the listing is ready in 10-13 ms; the rest is waiting for the frame, which varied between runs (17 or 53 ms per folder; bench/raw has the per-folder events).

method: FileManager release build (LTO), 5 runs after one warm-up run, each a fresh process with a fresh settings folder and a 1280x800 window. Timings come from an opt-in hook (FM_BENCH, off in normal use) that logs when the frame showing a listing has been painted; a steps file drives the session (open folders, switch to XL icons, scroll). The app memory figures are its own GetProcessMemoryInfo counters at those points. The comparison starts each app as a fresh process on one folder (one uncounted warm-up launch per folder first), reads its memory from outside once it settles, then closes its window. Apps run with their installed settings (File Pilot reads its own through the known-folder API); its settings files are put back afterwards. Fixtures are generated by bench/fixtures.ps1.
